spans.s: मणिः [maṇiḥ], [मण्-इन् स्त्रीत्वपक्षे वा ङीप्] (Said to be f. also, but rarely used)
A jewel, gem, precious stone; मणिर्लुठति पादेषु काचः शिरसि धार्यते । यथैवास्ते तथैवास्तां काचः काचो मणिर्मणिः
; अलब्धशाणोत्कषणा नृपाणां न जातु मौलौ मणयो वसन्ति
Anything best of its kind; cf. रत्न.
The fleshy excrescence on the neck of a goat (also written मणी in these senses).
An ingot, a lump (of gold); यथा सोम्यैकेन लोहमणिना सर्वं लोहमयं विज्ञातं स्यात् Ch.

. -Comp. -इन्द्रः, -राजः a diamond. -कण्ठः the blue jay. -कण्ठकः a cock.-कर्णिका, -कर्णी N. of a sacred pool in Benares. -काचः the feathered part of an arrow. -काञ्चनयोगः a rare combination of mutually worthy things. -काननम् the neck. -कारः a lapidary, jeweller; मणिकाराश्च ये केचित्
. -गुणः a quality of gems; षडश्रश्चतुरश्रो वृत्तो वा, तीव्ररागसंश्थानवानच्छः स्निग्धो गुरुरर्चिष्मानन्तर्गतप्रभः प्रभानु- लेपी चेति मणिगुणाः Kau.

. -ग्रीवः a son of Kubera. -तारकः the crane or Sārasa bird. -तुण्डः a striped hyena; Nighaṇṭaratnākara. -तुलाकोटिः a foot ornament consisting of jewels. -दण्ड a. having a handle adorned with jewels. -दर्पणः a jewelled mirror.
दीपः a lamp having jewels; मणिदीपप्रकाशितं ...... पश्येदं रङ्गमन्दिरम्
a jewel serving as a lamp. -दोषः a flaw or defect in a jewel.
द्वीपः the hood of the serpent Ananta.

N. of a fabulous island in the ocean of nectar; सुधासिन्धोर्मध्ये सुरविटपिवाटीपरिसरे । मणिद्वीपे नीपोपवनवति चिन्तामणिगृहे Saundaryalaharī. -धनुःm., -धनुस् n. a rainbow. -पाली a female keeper of jewels. -पुष्पकः N. of the conchshell of Sahadeva; नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ
a kind of bodice richly adorned with jewels.
(रम्) N. of a town in Kaliṅga.

the pit of the stomach, or a mystical circle on the navel (also मणि- पूरक); तदूर्ध्वे नाभिदेशे तु मणिपूरं महाप्रभम् । ...... मणिवद् भिन्नं तत्पद्मं मणिपूरं तथोच्यते Yogagrantha. ˚पतिः an epithet of Babhruvāhana. -प्रवेकः a most excellent jewel. -प्रभा N. of a metre.
बन्धः the wrist; रक्षाकरण्डकमस्य मणिबन्धे न दृश्यते Ś.7.
बन्धनम् fastening on of jewels, a string or ornament of pearls.
that part of a ring or bracelet where the jewels are set; collet; Ś.6.

the wrist; ...... मणिबन्धनात् कनकवलयं स्रस्तं स्रस्तं मया प्रतिसार्यते Ś.3.13.-बीजः, -वीजः the pomegranate tree. -भावरः an Indian crane; Nighaṇṭaratnākara. -भित्तिः f. N. of the palace of Śesa. -भूः f. a floor set with jewels. -भूमिः f.
a jewelled floor, floor inlaid with jewels.
मण्डपः N. of the residence of Śeṣa.
a crystal hall. -मन्तकम् a variety of diamonds; Kau.
माला a string or necklace of jewels.
a circular impression left by a bite (in amorous sports).

N. of a metre. -मेखल a. girdled with gems. -यष्टिः m., f. a jewelled stick, a string of jewels. -रत्नम् a jewel, gem. -रागः the colour of jewels. (-गम्) vermilion. -विग्रह a. jewelled; काञ्चनीं मणिविग्रहाम्

. -विशेषः an excellent jewel. -शिला a jewelled slab. -सरः a necklace; मणिसरममलं तारकपटलं नखदशशशिभूषिते Gīt. -शृङ्गः the god of the sun. -सूत्रम् a string of pearls. -सोपानम् a jewelled staircase. -स्तम्भः a pillar inlaid with jewels. -हर्म्यम् a jewelled or crystal palace.
मणिकः [maṇikḥ] कम् [kam], कम् 1 A water-jar; विवृद्धमूषिका रथ्या विभिन्न- मणिकास्तथा
The front part of the male organ of generation.
मणितम् [maṇitam], An inarticulate murmuring sound uttered at cohabitation; मणितं रतिकूजितम् Abh.
; सीत्कृतानि मणितं करुणोक्तिः Śi.1.75; संभ्रान्ता मणितवतीव पद्मवाटी Rām.
मणिमत् [maṇimat], a. Jewelled; गण्डस्थलोन्नतमुखं मणिमत्किरीटम् Bhāg. -m.
N. of a place of pilgrimage.
मण्ठः [maṇṭhḥ], A kind of baked sweetmeat.
To remember with regret, think of sorrowfully.
मण्डः [maṇḍḥ] ण्डम् [ṇḍam], ण्डम् [मन्-ड तस्य नेत्वं, मण़्ड्-अच् वा]
The thick oily matter or scum forming on the surface of any liquid.
The scum of boiled rice; नीवारौदनमण्डमुष्णमधुरम्
; तण्डुलानां सुसिद्धानां चतुर्दशगुणे जले । रसः सिक्थैर्विरहितो मण्ड इत्यभिधीयते Bhāva. P.
Foam, froth or scum in general; घृतात्परं मण्डमिवातिसूक्ष्मं ज्ञात्वा शिवं सर्वभूतेषु गूढम् Śvet.
The spirituous part of wine; राज्यं गतधनं साधो पीतमण्डां सुरामिव
decorating walls, floors &c. on festive occasions.
variegated colour.-जातम् the second change which takes place in sour milk. -प a. drinking scum or cream. -पीठिका two quarters of the compass. -हारकः a distiller of spirits &c.
मण्डकः [maṇḍakḥ], 1 A kind of baked flour.
A very thin kind of cake (Mar. मांडे); पयःस्मिता मण्डकमण्डनाम्बरा
Fond of ornaments. -नम् The act of decorating or ornamenting, adorning; मामक्षमं मण्डनकालहानेः
An ornament, decoration, embellishment; सा मण्डनान्मण्डनमन्वभुङ्क्त
; स्वाङ्गैरेव विभूषितासि वहसि क्लेशाय किं मण्डनम्

. Also मण्डना. -नः (or मण्डनमिश्रः) N. of a philosopher who is said to have been defeated in controversy by Śaṅkarāchārya; शिष्यप्रशिष्यैरुपगीयमानमवेहि तन्मण्डनमिश्रधाम Śaṅkaradigvijayam. -Comp. -कालः time for adorning.-प्रिय a. fond of ornaments.
मण्डपः [maṇḍapḥ], [मण्डं भूषां पाति पा-क, मण्ड्-कपन् वा]
A temporary hall erected on ceremonial occasions, an open hall; विवाहमण्डप.
A tent, pavilion; दीर्घेष्वमी नियमिताः पटमण्डपेषु निद्रां विहाय वनजाक्ष वनायुदेश्याः
An arbour, a bower, as in लतामण्डप; प्रत्यासन्नौ कुरबकवृतेर्माधवी- मण्डपस्य
A building consecrated to a deity.-Comp. -प्रतिष्ठा the consecration of a temple.
मण्डपकः [maṇḍapakḥ] पीका [pīkā], पीका 1 A small shed, shop.
An assembly of women. -न्ती A woman.
मण्डल [maṇḍala], a. [मण्ड्-कलच्] Round, circular; मण्डलाग्रा बृसीश्चैव गृहान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः
लम् A circular orb, globe, wheel, ring, circumference, anything round or circular; न्यग्रोधं च सुमण्डलम्
; so रेणुमण्डल, छाया- मण्डल, चापमण्डल, मुखमण्डल, स्तनमण्डल &c.
The charmed circle (drawn by a conjurer); मण्डले पन्नगो रुद्धो मन्त्रैरिव महाविषः
A disc, especially of the sun or moon; तेनातपत्रामलमण्डलेन
The halo round the sun or moon.
The path or orbit of a heavenly body.
A multitude, group, collection, assemblage, troop, company; एवं मिलितेन कुमारमण्डलेन Dk.; अखिलं चारिमण्डलम्
(In politics) The circle of a king's near and distant neighbours; मण्डलचरितम् Kau.

. (According to Kāmandaka quoted by Malli. the circle of a king's near and distant neighbours consists of twelve kings: विजिगीषु or the central monarch, the five kings whose dominions are in the front, and the four kings whose dominions are in the rear of his kingdom, the मध्यम or intermediate, and उदासीन or indifferent king. The kings in the front as well as in the rear are designated by particular names; see Malli. ad loc; cf. also Śi. 2.81. and Malli. thereon. According to some the number of such kings is four, six, eight, twelve or even more; see Mit. on

. According to others, the circle consists of three kings only: the प्राकृतारि or natural enemy, (the sovereign of an adjacent country), the प्राकृतमित्र natural ally, (the sovereign whose dominions are separated by those of another from the country of the central monarch with whom he is allied), and प्राकृतोदासीन or the natural neutral, (the sovereign whose dominions lie beyond those of the natural ally).
A particular position of the feet in shooting.
A kind of mystical diagram used in invoking a divinity.
A division of the Ṛigveda (the whole collection being divided into 1 Maṇḍalas or eight Aṣṭakas).
A kind of leprosy with round spots.
Sexual dalliance; नानाविचित्र- कृतमण्डलमावहन्तीम् Bil. Ch. (उत्तरपीठिका) 38.
A circular gait; हय इव मण्डलमाशु यः करोति
A group, assemblage; तन्मोचनाय तेनाशु प्रेरिता शिष्यमण्डली
Bent grass (दूर्वा).-Comp. -अग्र a. round-pointed. (-ग्रः) a bent or crooked sword, scimitar. (-ग्रम्) a surgeon's circular knife.
अधिपः, अधीशः, ईशः, ईश्वरः the ruler or governor of a district or province.
a king, sovereign.-आवृत्तिः f. circular movement; भ्रमिषु कृतपुटान्तर्मण्डला- वृत्तिचक्षुः

. -आसन a. sitting in a circle. -उत्तमम् a principal kingdom or district. -कविः a bad poet.-कार्मुक a. having a circular bow. -नाभिः the centre of a circle. -नृत्यम् a circular dance, dance in a ring.-न्यासः describing a circle. -पुच्छकः a kind of insect.-बन्धः the formation of a circle or roundness. -भागः an arc. -माडः a pavilion. -वटः the fig-tree forming a circle. -वर्तनम् drawing figures with some powder (Mar. रांगोळी घालणें); संमार्जनोपलेपाभ्यां गृहमण्डलवर्तनैः
. -वर्तिन् m. a ruler of a small province; स तुल्यातिशयध्वंसं यथा मण्डलवर्तिनाम्
. -वर्षः rain over the whole of a king's territory, general rain-fall.-वाटः a garden.
A kind of pose of an archer.
A circle with lines drawn for magical incantations. -कः A dog.
To make round or circular, form into a globe or circle.
To turn or whirl round; नानागतिर्मण्डलयन् जवेन
मण्डलायते [maṇḍalāyatē], Den. Ā. To form oneself into a circle, to coil oneself.
मण्डलायित [maṇḍalāyita], a. Round, circular. -तम् A ball, globe.
मण्डलिका [maṇḍalikā], a group, troop, band, crowd.
माण्डलिक [māṇḍalika], a. (-की f.) Relating to, or ruling a province.
कः The ruler of a province.
A sovereign with an annual income between 3 to 1 lacs of rupees; सामन्तः स नृपः प्रोक्तो यावल्लक्षत्रयावधि । तदूर्ध्वं दशलक्षान्तो नृपो माण्डलिकः स्मृतः ॥ Śukra.1.183.
मण्डलित [maṇḍalita], a. Rounded, made round or circular.
Forming a circle, made up into a coil; बाता मण्डलिनस्तीव्रा व्यपसव्यं प्रचक्रमुः
मण्डलीकः [maṇḍalīkḥ], A tributary king; तेजो निजं मुकुलयन्ति च मण्डलीकाः Kīr.
मण्डलीकृ [maṇḍalīkṛ], 8 U. To form into a ring or circle, to coil round.
Rounded, made circular, formed into a globe or circle.
To form a globe or circle.
मण्डित [maṇḍita], p. p. Adorned, decorated; मणिमयमकरमनोहर- कुण्डलमण्डितगण्डमुदारम् Gīt.; स्वयं च मण्डिता नित्यं परिमृष्टपरिच्छदा
मण्डित [maṇḍita], N. of one of the Gaṇādhipas of the Jains.
मण्डुकम् [maṇḍukam], The handle of a shield; स्यूते बाहौ मण्डुकश्लिष्ट- मुष्टेः Śi.18.21.
A frog; निपानमिव मण्डूकाः सोद्योगं नरमायान्ति विवशाः सर्वसंपदः Subhāṣ.
N. of a particular breed of horses.
The sole of a horse's hoof. कम् A kind of coitus or mode of sexual enjoyment.

N. of several plants. -Comp. -अनुवृत्तिः, -गतिः, -प्लुतिः f. 'the leap of a frog', skipping over or omitting at intervals (in grammar the word is used to denote the skipping of several Sūtras and supplying from a previous Sūtra); क्रियाग्रहणं मण्डूकप्लुत्यानुवर्तते Sk.-कुलम् a collection of frogs. -पर्णा, -पर्णिका, -पर्णी N. of several plants like मञ्जिष्ठा, ब्राह्मी etc. -योगः a kind of abstract meditation in which the person who meditates sits motionless like a frog; मण्डूकयोगनियतैर्यथान्यायं निषेविभिः
. -सरस् n. a pond full of frogs.
मण्डूरम् [maṇḍūram], Rust of iron, dross (used as a tonic).
To adorn, decorate; प्रभवति मण्डयितुं वधूरनङ्गः
A pearl-necklace of sixteen (or twenty) strings.
N. of one of the 9 treasures.
माणवकः [māṇavakḥ], 1 A youth, boy, lad, youngster (oft. used contemptuously).
A little man, dwarf; manikin; मायामाणवकं हरिम्
A pearl-necklace of sixteen (or twenty or fortyeight) strings; ग्रीवाद्भुतैवावदुशोभितापि प्रसाधिता माणवकेन सेयम्
माणव्यम् [māṇavyam], [माणवानां समूहः यत्] A company of lads or boys.
माणिका [māṇikā], A particular weight (equal to eight palas).
माणिक्यम् [māṇikyam], A ruby; शैले शैले न माणिक्यम् Subhāṣ.
माण्डप [māṇḍapa], a. Belonging to a temple.
